headword: {心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}
gloss: psychological description; portrayal of inner thoughts

definitions.gloss: psychological description; portrayal of inner thoughts and feelings
definitions.explanation: The depiction of a character's mental state, emotions, and inner world in literature, film, or other creative works. A key element of literary analysis.

examples.japanese: {心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}が{巧|たく}みだ。
この{小説|しょうせつ}は{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}の{心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}が{細|こま}かい。
examples.english: This novel has detailed psychological descriptions of its characters.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}の{心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れたサスペンス{映画|えいが}が{話題|わだい}になっている。
examples.english: A suspense film that focuses on the psychological portrayal of the criminal is attracting attention.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and critical term used when discussing novels, films, anime, manga, and other narrative works. Valued as a mark of quality writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}が{巧|たく}みだ (psychological portrayal is skillful)
- {心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}に{優|すぐ}れた (excelling in psychological description)
- {繊細|せんさい}な{心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ} (delicate psychological portrayal)
- {心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}が{浅|あさ}い (shallow psychological description)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {情景|じょうけい}{描写|びょうしゃ}: scene description — describes settings and surroundings rather than inner states
- {人物|じんぶつ}{描写|びょうしゃ}: character description — broader, includes physical appearance and behavior
